# apply_region_map_to_raspa_pdb_wrapped { #mofography.raspa_helper.apply_region_map_to_raspa_pdb_wrapped }

```python
raspa_helper.apply_region_map_to_raspa_pdb_wrapped(
    pdb_file,
    regions_cluster,
    unit_cell,
    natoms_per_molecule=1,
    index_list=None,
    symbol_map=None,
)
```

Applies a region map to a RASPA PDB file, wrapping coordinates to a single unit cell.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type   | Description                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| pdb_file            |        | the pdb file you want to analyze                                                                 | _required_ |
| regions_cluster     |        | the region map for a single unit cell                                                            | _required_ |
| unit_cell           |        | the unit cell matrix or ASE Atoms object containing the unit cell information                    | _required_ |
| natoms_per_molecule |        | number of atoms per molecule. This is currently only implemented for 1, defaults to 1 (optional) | `1`        |
| index_list          |        | list of indices of atoms to use in the pdb file. If None, all atoms are used                     | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                               |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A dictionary with the number of atoms in each cluster type and the total number of atoms. |
